title: Finite synthetic evidence loss and restoration feasibility pilot
question: Can a fixed plain model complete matched-fact facts/EAL/conventional decision tasks across critical evidence loss, positive and negative restoration, and noncritical gaps, while separate measurements distinguish substantive answer correctness from canonical decision correctness?

scope.system_or_population: Eight fresh AI-authored fictional source tasks: two logic families crossed with four availability causes, each with five scheduled evidence conditions.
scope.conditions: Pinned plain model gpt-4.1-nano-2025-04-14; one repeat; no native tools for donors or recipients; three reasoner contexts; prompted JSON; USD 2 cumulative budget.
scope.spatial_scope: Repository fixture state and API execution only; no people, deployment, or physical assets.
scope.temporal_scope: One common actual donor at position 0 and fresh independently cloned recipients at positions 2, 4, 6, 8, 10. These are artificial snapshot times, not actual longitudinal field observations.
exclusions: Population reliability, human developer outcomes, independent human task authoring, pure reasoning capability, model-class effects, superiority, cost savings, and principal-study power.
Existing pilot outcomes are motivation only and are not pooled with follow-up outcomes.

claims.statement: The bounded procedure can deliver and separately measure substantive and canonical decisions over the 120 scheduled recipient outputs within the shared budget.
claims.scope_limit: Execution and measurement feasibility on this fixed material set, model, and prompt configuration only.
claims.success_consequence: Proceed to a separately designed principal comparison after variance, ambiguity, and resource inputs are learned.
claims.failure_consequence: Repair delivery or measurement first; retain incomplete and failed attempts.

claims.statement: The fresh material set has 32 decisive and eight genuinely decision-critical unknown reference positions, with both restoration polarities and noncritical controls represented.
claims.scope_limit: Fixture apparatus calibration, not participant correctness or independent external validity.
claims.success_consequence: Use the finite material set to diagnose abstention and restoration behavior.
claims.failure_consequence: Block participant execution and repair reference or intervention construction.

assumptions.statement: Fact eligibility and three-valued composition describe the declared synthetic task, including false-conjunct and true-route domination.
assumptions.test_or_justification: 88 authored keys agree with two software implementations; 40 explicit requirement-state checks. A separate AI reviewer independently recalculated all 88 raw-fact keys and six boundary/mixed-blocker controls; see review/independent-reference-review.json. This remains same-orchestration AI review, not human external validation.
assumptions.failure_consequence: No correctness interpretation; correct material and regenerate frozen manifest.

assumptions.statement: The masked whole-answer rubric separates the correct communicated verdict and internally consistent explanation from contradictory, ambiguous, and missing answers. It does not measure explanation factual accuracy.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Calibrate on correct, incorrect, ambiguous, internally contradictory, conditional and absent synthetic answers before coding participant outputs.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Canonical counts may be reported but substantive quality remains unresolved.

assumptions.statement: Configured API prices and UTF-8/framing reservations conservatively bound charges; failed attempts remain charged or reserved.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Check official model/pricing before first request; provider journal enforces USD 2 cumulative ceiling and aborts unexpected model or usage.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Stop and inspect cost accounting; do not claim successful budget feasibility.

constructs.name: Substantive communicated-answer correctness
constructs.definition: The whole answer communicates exactly the reference decision and its explanation is internally consistent with that communicated decision. Factual explanation accuracy against task evidence is unassessed.
validity_evidence: Masked answer-text coding with separate canonical field and calibration cases; factual explanation accuracy unassessed
validity_threats: Shared AI judge errors, ambiguity, concise explanations, task-induced answer format

constructs.name: Canonical decision correctness
constructs.definition: A parsable designated decision enum equals the reference decision, whether or not surrounding prose is internally contradictory or factually inaccurate.
validity_evidence: Known correct and incorrect enum fixtures
validity_threats: Good enum can coexist with incorrect explanation; JSON compliance is not comprehension

constructs.name: Intervention/reference validity
constructs.definition: Critical gaps produce unknown; eligible positive and negative restoration produce the appropriate decisive result; noncritical gaps leave a decisive result.
validity_threats: Author and implementations share specification error; cause-domain confounding

design.rationale: Independent recipient clones reuse one common actual donor per task. Fixed facts/EAL/conventional contexts at each position isolate the delivered context comparison; finite controls diagnose blanket abstention and restoration polarity mistakes.
design.setting: Synthetic fixture plus actual API participant execution
design.temporal_structure: Common donor with independently forked evidence interventions; recipients are not serial carryover sessions.
design.assignment_method: Complete crossing of eight cases, five positions and three reasoners, fixed seed 20261002 shuffling block and variant order.
design.allocation_concealment: Not applicable to an automated finite crossing; frozen assignments precede participant calls.
design.masking: Whole-answer coders receive masked answer text without reasoner, condition label, task evidence, scores or model names. They code the communicated verdict and internal explanatory consistency; factual explanation accuracy is unassessed.
design.comparator: Within-case and within-position facts vs EAL vs conventional; within-case/reasoner complete vs critical_gap vs restored_positive vs restored_negative; noncritical has its declared decisive comparator.

units.observational_unit: One recipient answer; 120 scheduled outputs clustered within eight common donors and crossed reasoners/conditions
units.analysis_unit: Task block, with finite per-condition and reasoner cell tables
inclusion_criteria: All eight frozen tasks and every scheduled recipient variant; actual API attempts included
exclusion_criteria: Unscheduled odd continuity snapshots and donor answers from recipient accuracy denominator
units.recruitment_or_selection: No people; separate AI author in same session. Cases deliberately cover logic and availability combinations; domains differ across causes.

analysis.missing_data: Distinguish not-run, provider failure, malformed output, missing label, ambiguous answer and contradiction; denominators remain explicit.
